DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入場券を拝見します。こちらは大人の券一枚と、お子さんの券一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me see your admission tickets. One adult ticket and one child's ticket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買ってから気づいたのですが、子どもだけ別の区画になっています。隣で見られませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの券が別区画であることを伝え、隣で観戦する方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed after buying them that only my child's ticket is in a different section. Is there a way for us to watch next to each other?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child's ticket is in another section and ask how to watch side by side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子さんを一人にするのは心配ですね。券の区画を確認して、案内担当に空席を聞きます。お子さんは何歳ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You must be concerned about leaving your child alone. I'll check the sections and ask the seating staff about empty seats. How old is your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七歳です。席が離れるなら、二人ともまだ入らずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七歳だと答え、席が離れる場合は親子とも入場を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Seven. If the seats are apart, we'll both wait without going in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that your child is seven and say both of you will wait to enter if the seats are separated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お待たせしました。この練習試合では、空いている自由席の区画へ二人で移れるとのことです。元の席には戻らず、案内札の範囲でお座りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for waiting. For this practice game, you may both move to an available unreserved-seating section. Please stay within the area marked by the signs and don't return to the original seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で移ります。今いる友人にも、新しい区画の場所を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自由席への移動を受け入れ、友人へ場所を知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll move together. I'd also like to tell our friend already here where the new section is.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept moving to unreserved seats and say you want to tell your friend the location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一塁側の青い案内札が目印です。なお、大きな荷物は通路をふさがないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The blue sign on the first-base side is the landmark. Please make sure large belongings don't block the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この長い応援旗は持ち込めますか。振ると隣の人に当たりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 長い旗の持ち込み可否を尋ね、周囲への接触を心配していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I bring in this long cheering flag? If I wave it, it looks as though it could hit someone beside me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the long flag can be brought in and explain your concern about hitting others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この試合では長い旗は客席で使えません。持ち込みについては預かり担当に確認します。応援は手拍子でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Long flags cannot be used in the stands at this game. I'll check with the storage staff about bringing it in. Please cheer by clapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 旗の扱いが決まるまで待ってから、子どもと一緒に案内された席へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旗の扱いを確認した後に子どもと指定区画へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait until we know how to handle the flag, then go with my child to the seats you showed us.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go with your child to the indicated section after confirming what to do with the flag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで担当を呼びます。準備が整ったらご案内しますので、親子で観戦を楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the staff here, then. We'll guide you once everything is ready. Enjoy watching the game together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の箱を台に運びましょう。今日は魚種ごとの札を確かめてから仕分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's take the next box to the table. Today we'll check the species labels before sorting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱には札がありません。隣の箱と似た魚ですが、同じ扱いにしてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 札のない箱を見つけたと伝え、隣の箱と同じ扱いにできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This box has no label. The fish look similar to those in the next box; may we handle it the same way?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a box without a label and ask whether to handle it like the neighboring box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外見だけで決めず、その箱はいったん保留にします。どの船の荷物と一緒に届いたか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We won't decide from appearance alone; we'll put that box on hold. Do you remember which boat's cargo it arrived with?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い船から下ろした箱の列にありました。ただ、荷下ろしの途中で別の列が混ざったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤い船の箱の列にあったが途中で混ざった可能性もあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was in the row of boxes unloaded from the red boat. But another row may have become mixed in during unloading.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was in the red boat's row but could have become mixed with another row. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では出荷元の記録と照合します。赤い船の物と断定して書かないでください。保留用の台は右奥です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll compare it with the shipping-origin record. Don't write that it is definitely from the red boat. The holding table is at the back right.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右奥へ移すには台車を使いますか。床がぬれていて、一人で抱えるのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 床がぬれているため単独で抱えず台車を使いたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should we use a cart to move it to the back right? The floor is wet, and I'm uneasy about carrying it alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use a cart rather than carrying it alone because the floor is wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 台車を使い、通路の水を片づけてから二人で移します。氷も床に落ちているので、まず足元を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll use a cart and move it together after clearing the water from the passage. There is ice on the floor too, so let's check our footing first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路を片づけてから運びます。札がないことは、箱に貼るメモにも書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を片づけると答え、札の欠落をメモにも記すか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll clear the passage before moving it. Should I also write on the note attached to the box that the label is missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to clear the passage and check whether to note the missing label too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。札が外れていた場所と発見時刻を記してください。魚種と出荷先の欄は、照合できるまで空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Record where you found the box with its label missing and the discovery time. Leave the species and destination fields blank until we've matched the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発見は六時十分です。魚種は記入せず、その時刻と見つけた場所を残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六時十分という発見時刻と場所のみを残し、魚種は未記入にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found it at six ten. I won't enter a species; I'll keep just that time and the location where I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the six-ten discovery time and location and say you will leave the species blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その記録で確認を進めます。移動は私と一緒に行いましょう。ここまでお疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll use that record to proceed with the check. Let's move it together. Thank you for your work so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの菓子は試食もできます。ご自宅用でしょうか、お土産でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can sample these sweets too. Are they for home or a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場の十二人に五日後に配ります。人数分を分けられる箱を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十二人へ五日後に配るため分けられる包装の商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll give them to twelve people at work in five days. I'm looking for a box with packaging that can be divided among them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request separately packaged sweets to give twelve people in five days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十二個入りのこちらは一個ずつ包装されています。ただ、この箱の賞味期限は三日後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This box of twelve is individually wrapped, but its best-before date is in three days.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それだと配る日を過ぎますね。別の商品で、表示を見ながら選び直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の箱は配布日より期限が早いと指摘し、別商品の表示を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then it would be past the date when I give them out. Could I choose something else while checking the labels?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that the first box expires before distribution and ask to check another product's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの焼き菓子も個包装です。今ある箱の表示では賞味期限は二週間後で、直射日光と高温多湿を避けるよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: These baked sweets are individually wrapped too. The label on the box we have now says two weeks from now and to avoid direct sunlight, heat, and humidity.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 移動中は車に置きっぱなしにせず、持ち歩きます。原材料を全員に知らせたいので、表示の紙も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車に放置しないと述べ、原材料を周囲に知らせるための表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll carry them with me rather than leave them in the car while traveling. I'd like everyone to know the ingredients; is an information sheet included?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not leave them in the car and ask about ingredient information for others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原材料は外箱に印刷されています。個包装にも記載があるか、一つ見本を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The ingredients are printed on the outer box. Let's check a sample to see whether they're also listed on each wrapper.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 個包装にも書いてある方が助かります。箱を捨てた人にも、原材料を確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外箱がなくても各人が原材料を確認できる個包装を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if each wrapper had them too. I'd like people to be able to check the ingredients even if they've discarded the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request individual wrappers allowing each person to check ingredients without the outer box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本の個包装に原材料の記載があります。食物アレルギーのある方には、ご自身で表示を確認してもらってください。こちらは十二個入りで二千円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The sample wrapper lists the ingredients. Anyone with a food allergy should check the label themselves. This box has twelve and costs two thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その箱を一つください。渡す前に、賞味期限と保存方法も職場の人に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十二個入りを一箱購入し、配布前に期限と保存方法を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: One box of those, please. Before handing them out, I'll also tell my coworkers the best-before date and storage instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one box of twelve and say you will tell people the date and storage instructions before distribution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 十二個入りを一箱お包みします。持ち運びにもお気をつけて。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll wrap one box of twelve. Please take care while carrying it. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 看護師です。受付から腹痛と聞きました。いつから、どのあたりが痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'm a nurse. Reception told me you have abdominal pain. When did it start, and where does it hurt?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方六時ごろから、おへその周りが痛いです。さっきより強くなった気がして来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六時ごろからおへそ周辺が痛み、以前より強くなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Around my navel since about six this evening. I came because it seems to have grown stronger than before.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that pain around your navel began around six and has become stronger. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛みが強くなったのですね。吐いたり、意識が遠くなったりしたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the pain has intensified. Have you vomited or felt you were losing consciousness?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一度吐きました。意識ははっきりしていますが、立つと少しふらつきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回の嘔吐と起立時のふらつきを伝え、意識は明瞭だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I vomited once. I'm fully conscious, but I feel a little unsteady when I stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report vomiting once and unsteadiness on standing, and say your consciousness is clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩き回らず、こちらで座ってお待ちください。今までの病気や、今日飲んだ薬についても教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please sit here and wait rather than walk around. Also tell me about any past illnesses and medicine you've taken today.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市販の胃薬を飲みましたが、名前を覚えていません。箱の写真なら携帯にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の名前は不明だが箱の写真を携帯で提示できると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took an over-the-counter stomach medicine, but I don't remember the name. I have a photo of the box on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the medicine's name but can show a box photo on your phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見せていただけますか。服用した時間と量も医師に伝えます。詳しいことが日本語で言いにくければ、その点もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you show me the photo? I'll tell the doctor when and how much you took too. Please also let me know if explaining details in Japanese is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 七時に表示どおり一回分を飲みました。痛みの感じを細かく説明するのが難しいので、ゆっくり質問してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 七時に表示量を服用したと答え、細かな説明のため質問をゆっくりしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: At seven, I took one dose as indicated on the label. It's hard to describe the pain in detail, so could you ask me questions slowly?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the seven-o'clock dose taken as labeled and ask for slow questions to help explain details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一つずつ確認しますね。診察までに痛みが急に変わったり、気分が悪くなったりしたら、すぐ近くの職員を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check one thing at a time. If the pain suddenly changes or you feel unwell before the consultation, please immediately call a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この椅子で待ちます。変化があれば黙って我慢せず、職員に声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 着席して待ち、症状が変われば我慢せず職員へ知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait in this chair. If anything changes, I won't suffer silently; I'll tell a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait seated and notify staff rather than endure a change in symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お薬の写真と経過を医師に引き継ぎます。いったん失礼しますが、つらくなったらすぐお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the medicine photo and history to the doctor. I'll leave you for now, but tell us immediately if you feel worse.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 上着をお預かりします。気になる汚れや、受け取りのご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your jacket. Are there any stains you're concerned about or preferences for collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明後日の面接で着ます。袖にコーヒーをこぼしたので、そこを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明後日の面接に使う上着の袖にコーヒーをこぼしたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll wear it for an interview the day after tomorrow. I spilled coffee on the sleeve; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report coffee spilled on the sleeve of a jacket needed for an interview the day after tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袖口に跡がありますね。通常の洗いで残った場合、別の染み抜きを試すかどうか伺いたいのですが、いつ付いた汚れですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a mark at the cuff. We'd like to ask whether to try separate stain removal if normal cleaning leaves it. When did the stain happen?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日です。自宅では洗わず、乾いた布で少し押さえただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日付いた汚れで洗濯はせず乾いた布で押さえたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday. I didn't wash it at home; I only pressed it a little with a dry cloth.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the stain happened yesterday and you dabbed it with a dry cloth without washing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生地と表示を確認してお預かりします。明日の夕方の受け取りは予定できますが、追加の染み抜きは時間が延びる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the fabric and care label before accepting it. We can plan collection tomorrow evening, but additional stain removal may take longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 面接に間に合うことを優先します。通常の洗いで残ったら、追加作業に進む前に連絡をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期日に間に合うことを優先し、追加の染み抜き前に連絡を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Being ready for the interview is the priority. If the mark remains after normal cleaning, please contact me before starting additional work.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize meeting the deadline and ask to be contacted before extra stain removal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。染みが完全に落ちると約束はできません。ご連絡する電話番号を、この欄に記入していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We can't promise the stain will come out completely. Could you write your contact phone number in this field?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに書きます。昼間は電話に出られないことがあるので、留守番電話に要件を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を記入し、昼間に出られない場合は留守番電話へ要件を残すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write it here. I sometimes can't answer during the day, so please leave a message on my voicemail.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter your number and ask them to leave a voicemail if you cannot answer during the day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように記録します。こちらの控えに受取予定と品物の特徴を記載しました。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record that. This receipt shows the planned collection time and the item's description. Please check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紺色の上着一着、明日の夕方ですね。控えを持って取りに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紺色の上着一着と翌日夕方の受取予定を復唱し、控えを持参すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: One navy-blue jacket, tomorrow evening, correct? I'll bring the receipt to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat one navy-blue jacket and collection tomorrow evening, and say you will bring the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お預かりしました。追加の判断が必要ならご連絡します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we've accepted it. We'll contact you if an additional decision is needed. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。食券機でお困りでしょうか。注文の内容なら私が伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you having trouble with the ticket machine? I can help with your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: チャーシュー麺のボタンが押せません。赤く表示されていますが、売り切れですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チャーシュー麺の赤い表示と押せない状態を示し売り切れか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't press the chashu ramen button. It's displayed in red; is it sold out?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the red, unresponsive chashu ramen button and ask whether it is sold out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今日は追加用のチャーシューがなくなりました。普通のラーメンは注文できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, we've run out of extra chashu pork today. You can still order regular ramen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら普通のラーメンにします。もやしを追加するボタンは、どれでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普通のラーメンへ変更し、もやし追加のボタンの位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll have regular ramen. Which button is for extra bean sprouts?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Switch to regular ramen and ask where the extra-bean-sprout button is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左下の『野菜追加』です。その券ではもやしを増やします。麺の硬さの希望があれば、食券を渡すときにおっしゃってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: ‘Extra vegetables’ at the bottom left. That ticket adds bean sprouts. If you have a preference for noodle firmness, please tell us when handing over the tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚買いました。麺はやわらかめで、もやしを追加してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚の食券を渡し、麺をやわらかめにしてもやしを加えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've bought two tickets. Please make the noodles softer and add bean sprouts.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand over two meal tickets and request softer noodles with extra bean sprouts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普通のラーメン、野菜追加、麺はやわらかめですね。丼は熱いので、提供時にはお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Regular ramen with extra vegetables and softer noodles, then. The bowl will be hot, so be careful when it's served.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 汁を飲む前に味を見たいので、れんげを一つもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味を確認するためれんげ一つを用意してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to taste the soup before drinking it, so could I have a soup spoon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for one soup spoon to check the flavor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: れんげはカウンターの右端にあります。取りにくければこちらからお渡しします。お席でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The spoons are at the far right of the counter. If they're hard to reach, we can give you one. Could you wait at your seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右端なら取れます。れんげを用意して、この席で料理を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分でれんげを取れると答え、現在の席で料理を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can reach the far right. I'll get a spoon ready and wait for the food in this seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can get a spoon yourself and will wait for the meal in your current seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。でき上がったらお声をかけます。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We'll call you when it's ready. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類の発送ですね。お届け先の住所を確認します。マンション名の後に部屋番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're sending documents, correct? I'll check the destination address. Is there a room number after the apartment building's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三〇二号室です。封筒に書き忘れました。まだ発送前なので、ここで追記できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三〇二号室の記入漏れを伝え、発送前に窓口で追記してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Room three hundred and two. I forgot to write it on the envelope. Since it hasn't been sent yet, may I add it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the missing room number three hundred and two and ask to add it at the counter before shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今なら書き足せます。宛名が読みやすいように余白へ記入してください。配達についてご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, you can add it now. Write it in the blank space so the address remains legible. Do you have any delivery preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発送後の状況を確認したいです。追跡できる方法を案内してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送後の状況を確認できるサービスの案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to check its status after sending. Please explain a method with tracking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request information on a service allowing shipment-status checks after mailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追跡できる国内向けのサービスを比較してご案内します。相手の郵便受けに届ける方法と、対面で受け取る方法があります。どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare domestic services with tracking. There are mailbox delivery and in-person receipt options. Which would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手は昼間留守なので、郵便受けに届ける方法を希望します。書類は折らずに送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日中不在の相手へ郵便受けで届け、書類は折らずに送りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient is out during the day, so I'd prefer mailbox delivery. I'd like to send the documents without folding them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request mailbox delivery to a recipient absent during the day and mailing without folding the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その大きさと厚さで利用できる専用封筒があるか確認します。お急ぎの場合も、到着日を確約できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether a dedicated envelope is available for that size and thickness. Even if you're in a hurry, we may not be able to guarantee an arrival date.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 締切は来週です。今日出した場合のお届けの目安と、料金を確認してから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週の締切を示し、今日発送した場合の目安と料金を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The deadline is next week. I'd like to decide after checking the delivery estimate if sent today and the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give next week's deadline and ask to compare the delivery estimate for mailing today and the charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この発送先についての目安と、現在の料金をご案内します。こちらの専用封筒なら折らずに入ります。料金と取扱条件の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain the estimate for this destination and the current charge. This dedicated envelope will hold them without folding. Please read the charges and handling conditions shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を確認しました。この方法で送ります。追跡番号のある控えをなくさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示された条件を確認して発送方法を選び、追跡番号の控えを保管すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the information. I'll send them this way. I'll make sure not to lose the receipt with the tracking number.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the displayed conditions, choose the mailing method, and say you will keep the tracking receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では書類を封入してから受け付けます。部屋番号も確認できました。お手続きありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-ANAN-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll accept them once you've put the documents inside. We've checked the room number too. Thank you for completing the procedure.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから山道へ入る予定ですか。出発前に、帰りの交通手段も確かめておきましょう。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to enter the mountain trail now? Before leaving, let's check how you'll get back too.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山の上まで行きたいのですが、今日はバスで帰ります。登って下りるのに何時間くらい必要ですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 山頂へ行きたく帰りはバスで往復所要時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to the top, but I'm going back by bus today. About how many hours do I need to climb up and down?
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to reach the summit and return by bus, and ask the round-trip walking time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経路や歩く速さで変わります。時刻表と案内図を見ながら考えましょう。乗る予定のバスは何時ですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: It depends on the route and your pace. Let's consider it with the timetable and map. What time is your intended bus?

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手元の時刻表では、十六時十分です。ただ、この表が今日も有効かはまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻表では十六時十分だが当日も有効か未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: The timetable I have says four ten p.m. But I haven't checked whether this timetable is valid today.
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the timetable's four-ten-p.m. time and say you have not checked its validity today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず運行元の最新情報を確認してください。バスの時刻が決まっても、山頂までの往復に余裕があるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please check the operator's latest information. Even once you know the bus time, you may not have enough time for the round trip to the summit.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から山頂を目指すのはやめます。手前の分岐まで行って戻る計画なら、どう考えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今から山頂を目指さず手前の分岐で戻る計画を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't aim for the summit starting now. How should I plan a trip only to the junction before it and back?
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give up attempting the summit now and ask about turning back at the earlier junction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分岐までの目安を確認して、引き返す時刻を先に決めましょう。途中の天候や足元が悪ければ、その手前でも戻る必要があります。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the estimated time to the junction and decide your turnaround time first. If weather or footing is poor along the way, you'll need to turn back even before that.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者とも引き返す時刻を共有します。案内図に通行止めの表示がなくても、入口の掲示を見たほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引き返す時刻を同行者と共有し図に通行止めがなくても入口掲示を見るべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll share the turnaround time with my companion too. Even if the map shows no closure, should we check the notice at the entrance?
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share the turnaround time with your companion and ask whether to check entrance notices even without a closure on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。入口の掲示や当日の情報も確認してください。図だけを頼りに進まず、判断できない状況なら入山を見送ってください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the entrance notices and today's information too. Don't proceed relying only on the map; if you can't judge the situation, don't enter the mountain.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: バスと入口の掲示を確認してから決めます。時間に余裕がなければ、小屋の周りを見るだけにします。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: バスと入口掲示確認後に決め余裕がなければ小屋周辺を見るだけにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after checking the bus and entrance notice. If there isn't enough time, we'll just look around the hut.
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after checking the bus and entrance notices and only explore around the hut if time is short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰りの時間を優先してお考えください。道中も状況を見直しながら、気をつけて行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-TKS-MIYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please prioritize the return time. Reassess conditions along the way too, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チェックインの前に、今日の利用上の注意をご説明します。お持ちの調理器具は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before check-in, I'll explain today's usage precautions. What cooking equipment have you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の夕食を作るために、小型の炭火コンロを持ってきました。区画内で使えるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の夕食用の小型炭火コンロを区画内で使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought a small charcoal stove to make dinner for two. I'd like to know whether we can use it in our pitch.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a small charcoal stove for two people's dinner can be used in your pitch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 器具の種類だけでなく、今日の風の状況も確認が必要です。地面に直接置く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check not just the type of equipment but today's wind conditions too. Are you planning to put it directly on the ground?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 脚付きなので地面には触れません。ただ、風が強くなってきたので、使わないほうがよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脚付きで地面に触れないが強風のため使用を迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has legs, so it won't touch the ground. But the wind is getting stronger, so I'm unsure whether we should avoid using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the stove has legs and does not touch the ground but stronger wind makes you unsure about using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用の可否を今の管理者の案内で確認しましょう。許可が出ても風の変化には注意が必要です。火を使わない食事は用意されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check current permission with the manager. Even if permitted, you need to watch for changing winds. Do you have food that doesn't need cooking?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンと缶詰があります。今日はそれを食べて、炭を使わずに過ごすことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パンと缶詰を食べて今日は炭を使わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have bread and canned food. We'll eat that today and spend our stay without using charcoal.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to eat bread and canned food and not use charcoal today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら火の準備はせずにおいてください。未使用の炭も、雨にぬれないよう保管しましょう。ほかに確認したい設備はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please don't prepare a fire. Store the unused charcoal so rain won't wet it either. Is there any other facility you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食器を洗う場所を教えてください。缶の汁を流してよいかも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食器を洗う場所と缶の汁を流してよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me where to wash dishes. I'd also like to check whether it's all right to pour canned-food liquid down the drain.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to wash dishes and whether canned-food liquid may be poured down the drain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 洗い場へご案内します。汁や食べ残しの扱いは、こちらの掲示で確認してください。迷ったら流す前に受付へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you the washing area. Check this notice for handling liquid and leftovers. If unsure, please ask reception before pouring anything out.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に掲示を読みます。風や雨がさらに強まった場合の連絡先も、ここで控えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示を先に読み風雨が強まった場合の連絡先を控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read the notice first. I'll also note the contact here in case the wind or rain gets even stronger.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read the notice first and record the contact for worsening wind or rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先と退避の案内はこちらです。困ったときは早めにご連絡ください。それでは、無理のないご滞在を。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the contact details and evacuation guidance. Please contact us early if you're having trouble. Have a stay within your comfort limits.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お疲れさまでした。予約のお名前を伺って、宿泊内容を確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome after your journey. May I have the reservation name so I can check your stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山田で、一泊を予約しています。夕食も申し込んだつもりですが、メールには朝食しか書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 山田名義の一泊予約で夕食も申し込んだつもりだがメールは朝食のみだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yamada, for one night. I thought I'd booked dinner too, but the email only mentions breakfast.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your one-night Yamada reservation was intended to include dinner but the email mentions only breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号で照合しますね。こちらの記録も一泊朝食付きです。夕食付きへの変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll compare the reservation number. Our record also says one night with breakfast. Would you like to change to include dinner?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追加できるならお願いしたいです。ただ、料金を聞いてから決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕食を追加できれば希望するが料金を聞いてから決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to if it can be added. But may I decide after hearing the price?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you would like dinner if available but want to decide after hearing the charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もちろんです。今夜の準備が可能か厨房へ確認し、追加料金もあわせてお伝えします。お連れ様はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. I'll check with the kitchen whether dinner can be prepared tonight and tell you the additional charge too. Is anyone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人です。用意が難しければ外で食べますので、食事場所を探すための地図がほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で準備が難しければ外食するため周辺地図を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm alone. If preparing dinner is difficult, I'll eat out, so I'd like a map to find somewhere to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are alone and request a local map for eating out if dinner cannot be prepared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周辺の地図をお渡しできますが、各店の今夜の営業は別途ご確認ください。食事の確認中に、チェックアウトのご希望時刻を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can give you a local map, but please check each restaurant's opening tonight separately. While we check the meal, may I ask your preferred checkout time?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日は朝のバスに乗るので、七時半には出たいです。朝食を食べられる時間も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 朝のバスに乗るため七時半に出たいと伝え朝食の時間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm catching a morning bus tomorrow, so I'd like to leave by seven thirty. Please also tell me when breakfast is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave at seven thirty for a morning bus and ask breakfast hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 朝食の開始時刻と精算方法を、今夜の夕食の確認と一緒にご案内します。時間が合わなければ、朝食の扱いもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the breakfast start time and payment method together with the dinner confirmation. If the timing doesn't work, please ask about how breakfast can be handled too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、食事の時刻と追加料金を聞いてから予定を決めます。バスの時刻は自分でも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食事時刻と追加料金を聞いて予定を決めバスの時刻は自分でも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll decide my plans after hearing the meal times and additional charge. I'll check the bus time myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will plan after hearing meal times and extra charges and will check the bus time yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してご案内します。それまでロビーでひと息おつきください。どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check and explain. Until then, please take a rest in the lobby and make yourself comfortable.
